decision: Final undeterminable sample hold. The completed author OSF RPP report positively identifies its own project and explicitly prints 39 recruited participants and 23 final complete-data participants. Its enumerated participant exclusions do not reconcile those counts, and its functional-block omissions are not stated participant exclusions. The document also reports a deviation in unknown-name modeling. The supplied report does not provide a positive nonnumeric bridge establishing the identical cohort and analysis for the cited 2017 journal version. Do not infer the journal sample from matching degrees of freedom, call the source accounting a typo, repair the arithmetic to 27, or transfer an earlier project report count by default. The sample evidence remains available, but no correction or verification gain is promoted. Previously held effect-size and p-value fields and all protected decisions remain unchanged. No source acquisition or new model rule.
